Confirmation of accuracy
This application is completed to the best of my ability in accuracy, truthfulness and knowledge. I understand that providing false or inaccurate information will result in withdrawal of the application and dismissal if offered.
Duplication Policy
By submitting an application through this job portal, I confirm that (i) this is my only campus application in this current application round; and (ii) at least 90 days have elapsed since the submission date of any previous campus applications and this application. I confirm and agree, that if I have submitted multiple job applications then PwC China may withdraw all applications including any job offers.
